assets.name: scene-beat_001
assets.description: Cinematic editorial ligne claire comic illustration, wide establishing shot of an urban bedroom interior in Jakarta. A digital alarm clock on a wooden nightstand glows sharply reading 09:00 AM. Morning tropical sun rays stream through venetian blinds casting geometric linear shadows across white rumpled bedsheets. A modern smartphone lies face down beside an unfinished ceramic mug of black coffee. Clean uniform 3px black ink contour lines, muted flat gouache wash in warm cream, muted slate blue, and morning gold, minimal textural shading, graphic novel aesthetic.

assets.name: scene-beat_002
assets.description: Detailed spot illustration of a sleek smartphone held in a hand, angled slightly toward the viewer. The phone screen displays a vivid crimson-red financial trading interface with ticker charts plunging vertically, bold white text reading -40.28% and Total Return: Rp -142.500.000 in acute capital loss. Crisp distinct black ink outlines (3px), transparent background, vibrant alert red watercolor wash on screen contrasting with soft neutral hand tones, clean graphic linework, editorial financial press drawing style.

assets.name: scene-beat_008
assets.description: Spot illustration of vintage brass balanced scales of justice resting on an Indonesian law code ledger. On the left pan sits a polished green cube engraved PERMINTAAN (DEMAND), and on the right pan sits a matching blue cube engraved PENAWARAN (SUPPLY), perfectly suspended in theoretical harmony. Isolated on clean transparent background, immaculate black ink contour lines, rich warm gouache brass patina with emerald and navy highlights, editorial economic diagram style.

assets.name: scene-beat_009
assets.description: Widescreen dual-panel environmental composition. On the left half: a bustling Indonesian container port with towering yellow gantry cranes loading cargo under bright blue skies, green arrow vectors ascending into the clouds. On the right half: a silent, rusted industrial warehouse with chained steel gates and falling leaves under overcast rainy skies, red vector arrows pointing downward. Sharp ligne claire ink contours, contrasting vibrant cerulean/sun yellow washes against dull pewter/rust gouache, high-concept economic journalism framing.

assets.name: scene-beat_010
assets.description: Symbolic spot illustration of an antique leather-bound fairy tale book with ornate gold lettering reading DONGENG PASAR MODAL (FABLES OF CAPITAL MARKETS). A sharp surgical steel scalpel slices cleanly through the middle of the book, exposing tangled marionette strings and brass control gears concealed inside the hollowed pages. Isolated on transparent background, meticulous uniform 3px black ink linework, deep crimson leather, brass gold, and cold surgical steel gouache washes, satirical investigative documentary art.

assets.name: scene-beat_016
assets.description: Split-perspective widescreen composition: an ultra-clean macro close-up of a high-resolution trading terminal monitor displaying a daily candlestick chart. The price line of an obscure small-cap stock has been completely flatlined across months in a narrow 50-rupiah corridor, appearing entirely dead and abandoned. Below in the sub-window, microscopic, rhythmic, perfectly uniform volume histogram bars appear at exact timed intervals like an artificial heartbeat monitor. Ligne claire editorial style, muted grid background in dark charcoal, stark white price path, pale gouache color wash, clinical financial documentary aesthetic.

assets.name: scene-beat_018
assets.description: Overhead cinematic table shot of an ornate dark mahogany boardroom desk. Two pairs of hands in immaculate bespoke navy suit cuffs and gold cufflinks reach across the table. The left hand of one passes a crisp certified Indonesian share scrip to the right hand of another, while simultaneously another hand beneath transfers the exact same certificate back via an automated conveyor slot. Multiple glowing brokerage terminal keyboards and stamp seals surround them. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, editorial comic ligne claire style, crisp 3px black outlines, rich mahogany wood tones and deep emerald green desk blotter flat watercolor wash.

assets.name: scene-beat_023
assets.description: Hero prop spot illustration of an official corporate consortium agreement document folder opened diagonally. Inside rests a formal partnership memorandum stamped with a heavy red lacquer wax seal bearing interlocking globe symbols and a blue stamp reading 'FOREIGN CAPITAL INJECTION / VALUTA ASING'. Crisp fountain pen signatures and neat legal clauses visible. French-Belgian ligne claire style, uniform 3px bold black ink outlines, flat gouache palette of cream parchment, crimson wax, deep navy ink, and subtle gold foil accents, isolated on pure white background.

assets.name: scene-beat_024
assets.description: Atmospheric architectural establishing shot of the grand facade of a neoclassical capital market regulatory headquarters in Jakarta. Massive fluted stone columns flank a grand entrance, but a wide structural gap and illuminated opening split the marble stairs and foundation, creating an open backdoor pathway. Shadows of briefcase-carrying corporate figures stroll effortlessly through the gap under ambient Jakarta dusk sky. Clear ligne claire comic line art, strong uniform ink contours, desaturated stone grey, muted limestone beige, and warm amber lantern lighting spilling from the loophole.

assets.name: scene-beat_027
assets.description: Dramatic panoramic allegorical environment showing the edge of a deep dark reflection pool. A massive, tailored pinstripe-cuffed arm drops a shining golden fish hook disguised as a miniature glowing company dividend token into the water. Hundreds of frantic, wide-eyed carp and koi fish leap furiously toward the shiny surface with open mouths, splashing droplets. Graphic editorial comic art style, dynamic Hergé-inspired ligne claire ink contours, deep navy blue water, radiant warm yellow bait luminescence, and rich terracotta accents.

assets.name: scene-beat_028
assets.description: First-person perspective looking directly into a multi-monitor algorithmic trading station showing the BEI / IDX market depth order book. The 'BID' column shows stacked glowing emerald green numbers accumulating to '1,450,000 LOT' and '2,800,000 LOT' against an empty red ask column, depicting an artificial supply freeze. Reflections of an anxious trader's wide eyes in the glass monitors, sticky notes around the bezel with scribbled tickers. Ligne claire aesthetic, precise mechanical ink line work, glowing cyber-emerald green, midnight charcoal, and cream paper tones.

assets.name: scene-beat_032
assets.description: Isolated spot illustration of an antique brass mechanical metering funnel mechanism, releasing single heavy stamped equity tokens one by one with calculated clockwork precision. Clean crisp ligne claire ink contour lines, warm gouache wash in ochre, dull brass, and aged paper ivory. Fine mechanical gears, tick marks, and calibration levers visible on the side of the dispenser tube. Soft drop shadow underneath, purely isolated on clean canvas background, crisp vector-like finish, no background clutter.

assets.name: scene-beat_048
assets.description: Editorial symbolic ligne claire spot illustration of a classic marble chessboard viewed from a low dramatic 45-degree angle. A fragile wooden retail pawn piece stands alone on a cracked checkered square, encircled by towering, imposing obsidian chess pieces shaped like corporate high-rises and banker silhouettes, a large clean question mark subtly drafted in drafting-pen blueprint lines above, uniform clean black ink linework (3px), muted ivory, charcoal, and warm sepia tones, clean isolated background.
